edges: Governor Robert P. Casey signed a writ declaring the date for a special election under the Pennsylvania law.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: John S. Trinsey Jr. challenged the constitutionality of the Pennsylvania law regarding special elections.

multi_hop_neighbors.neighbor: United States District Court for the Eastern District of Pennsylvania
multi_hop_neighbors.edge: The United States District Court for the Eastern District of Pennsylvania heard John S. Trinsey Jr.'s case.

multi_hop_neighbors.neighbor: Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit
multi_hop_neighbors.edge: The Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit ruled that the Pennsylvania law on special elections did not violate the constitution.
